license_note: OpenAI provides the release as a managed service under the OpenAI Services Agreement, which permits customer applications but licenses no model weights for self-operation.

license_evidence.scope: Commercial access to GPT-Realtime-Whisper through the OpenAI API and related OpenAI services

access_boundary: This record represents the GPT-Realtime-Whisper release of May 2026, a streaming speech-to-text model served through the v1/realtime/transcription_sessions endpoint. The deprecated whisper-1 and GPT-4o Transcribe family, the gpt-transcribe and gpt-live-transcribe successors, the Realtime API platform, and later OpenAI releases remain separate service or product boundaries.
strengths: OpenAI documents the model page, launch date, and the transcription endpoint
The release is explicitly outside the deprecated transcription family named in the deprecations page
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation
The snapshot identity is alias-only with nothing pinnable, and the release is served only through one dedicated endpoint

evidence.label: Official API deprecations and model lifecycle page
